messages:
Finn: Quick poll 10am stair sprint vs 12:30pm row challenge this week? tiny brag prize: free snack from the kitchen shelf. :running:
Asha: Stair sprint all the way. Office stairs are my nemesis and my flex. :sweat_smile:
Tom: I vote row. low-impact knees appreciated. also i can bring a little tally board.
Nia: i'm down for either. can we have a 'most dramatic finish' category with a sticker? :medal:
Finn: yes stickers. @steps-bot can you run a steps tally?
steps-bot: steps-bot: I can track stair sprints. Reply "sprint" in thread after you finish and I'll log it. For rowing, DM me "row done" with minutes.
Asha: sprint (Mon), sprint (Wed)
Tom: row (Tue) 12m steady, row (Thu) maybe 8m
Nia: tentative sprint Mon, will try to do one row too. travel day = scaled counts.
Finn: rules: 2 reps of sprint (up+down) = one entry. honesty in the house. :yum:
Asha: also propose a silly award: "Most Convincing Breathless" for best photo. winner gets a mystery snack.
Tom: i will prepare a small whiteboard for times. can someone snag a couple of stickers from the printer cabinet?
Nia: i can. also i'll bring a tiny bell to ring for dramatic finishes.
Finn: calendar invites incoming. winner announced Friday 4pm with confetti gif. :tada:
Asha: pumped. may the least graceful lungs win.
Tom: may the rows be steady and the snacks plentiful.
Nia: See you on the stairs (or the erg)!
